name: Spondon Saha
title: CyberSecurity Researcher & SQA Engineer
heroLines: I identify vulnerabilities, secure systems, and share knowledge to make the digital world safer.
Specializing in web application security, penetration testing, and security research.

paragraphs: I'm Spondon Saha, a Security-focused SQA Engineer combining formal manual and automation testing training with hands-on offensive security experience.
I work across functional, regression, REST API, GraphQL, Android application, and web application testing with a particular interest in finding the security defects that typical QA workflows miss.

My certifications include Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) and Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), alongside ongoing training in Manual & Automation Testing. I'm especially drawn to web application security, API testing (REST & GraphQL), vulnerability assessment, and bug bounty methodology — areas I explore hands-on through platforms like Bugcrowd, YesWeHack, and HackerOne.
I'm currently pursuing my B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering, and I build tools like my QA test case management dashboard to bring more structure and speed to security and QA testing alike.

projects.title: Demoblaze Registration - Manual & Security Testing
projects.summary: Manual QA project testing the Demoblaze registration flow functional, boundary, i18n, and security testing.
projects.description: An end-to-end manual QA project covering test planning, test case design, and execution against the Demoblaze e-commerce demo's registration flow. Includes functional, boundary, and internationalization (CJK/emoji) testing, along with security-adjacent checks HTTP method tampering, SQL/XSS injection, race conditions, and rate-limit enforcement each backed by a documented defect. Includes a full Test Plan, Test Strategy, and a dropdown-driven Test Case suite with auto-updating status dashboard.

projects.title: Bug Bounty Methodology
projects.summary: A public write-up of the recon-to-report workflow used across bug bounty engagements scoping, enumeration, and triage.
projects.description: A structured methodology covering how targets are scoped, how attack surface is enumerated (subdomains, endpoints, parameters), which classes of vulnerabilities get prioritized first, and how findings are documented for maximum clarity and payout. Written to be a living reference, updated as tooling and techniques evolve.

projects.title: SQA Checklist
projects.summary: A practical collection of software testing checklists for ensuring comprehensive test coverage and quality.
projects.description: A structured collection of software testing checklists covering key areas such as functional, UI/UX, API, security, performance, and cross-browser testing. Designed as a practical reference to help testers ensure thorough test coverage and maintain consistent quality throughout the testing process.A comprehensive, interactive Software Quality Assurance checklist covering the full SDLC from requirements analysis and test planning to security, performance, release readiness, and post-release monitoring. Built as a practical, evolving reference for QA professionals and continuous testing improvement.

projects.title: SSRF Bible
projects.summary: A comprehensive SSRF reference covering detection, bypass techniques, cloud exploitation, escalation, and curated learning resources.
projects.description: A comprehensive reference for Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), covering detection, bypass techniques, cloud exploitation, internal service attacks, and SSRF-to-RCE escalation. Built as a practical, evolving resource with payloads, writeups, tools, and learning materials for authorized security testing and research.

projects.title: Pwn-Paper
projects.summary: A streamlined bug bounty report generator designed to create clean, structured, and professional vulnerability reports.
projects.description: A lightweight, single-file vulnerability report generator that transforms raw security findings into polished, professional reports. Built for bug bounty hunters, pentesters, and security researchers, with live preview, CVSS rating, Markdown copy, PDF export, autosave, and customizable sections—all without installations, accounts, or servers.
